title: Making games with UI that don't suck
author: kiteboundventures
selftext: Using mostly codex, sometimes a bit of Claude code but I can never seem to get a polished or decent looking UI for most of my games. Any suggestions or tools? I generate the assets via gpt 5.6 image 2 which looks OK but codex doesn't seem to do a good job putting them all together.

comments.author: Lewis_Hashbrown
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/5p4ht3t97vkh1.jpeg?width=1080&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=7728378701bb996ffe2d6feb633ded6365b2d85d

I found it best to let Claude make the menu with all the assets, then I ask it to give me Ingame sliders for everything with position, scale, tilt whatever is needed. I then move everything I need to where I want it and claude saves the new values.

No idea if it's the most efficient way but works for me.

replies.author: Right-Statement367
replies.body: That’s actually a good idea. I should try this as well:)

replies.author: kiteboundventures
replies.body: Wow I hadn't thought of this, will give it a go. But sometimes even the looks don't look as great so will need to go in to touch up the art myself

replies.author: Lewis_Hashbrown
replies.body:
Yea I found anything ai struggles with I ask it to make a tool so I can take over. Normally helps fix most things.

I agree sometimes the assets that get generated never look quite right. I either change up the prompt or as you said touch it up myself

replies.author: f3ydr4uth4
replies.body: Sorry if I’m stupid but do you have a concrete example with a rough prompt? I’m not quite understanding what you mean.

replies.author: Lewis_Hashbrown
replies.body:
I'll get chatgpt to make a concept image, I'll play around with multiple prompts till I get something I like. Then ask chatgpt to give me a asset sheet with a transparent background that I can use to create the concept Ingame.

But most menus I normally go back and revise 2-3 times as I add more features or slightly change the game etc

replies.author: f3ydr4uth4
replies.body: Ah right and what about the sliders? Sorry I don’t understand that.

replies.author: Lewis_Hashbrown
replies.body:
Say I want to move the text or images inside the daily run button because where ai put it was wrong.

I'd ask Claude to give me Ingame sliders with the options to move, scale etc. I'd load the game up and there would be sliders that show where I can make the adjustment and also a save button. Once it's in the palace I want it I press save and claude then knows that's how I want it so it changes the code to make it always like that.

All the menus I've built are multiple layers for each button. So for example the daily run button is. Button background, text, chest image, sun icon. All these are seperate assets

comments.author: NovaGuarda
comments.body: Just imagine the AI how you want it, go to photoshop and draw wireframes or a concept. Then have AI implement it. AI is good at implementation, not creativity or assets
